de2.P1.C8.ghi_chu: Dap an luu A (2000) sai va khong co phuong an dung: khoang bien thien cua mau ghep nhom = dau phai nhom cuoi - dau trai nhom dau = 26000-20000 = 6000, khong co trong cac phuong an; loi giai tinh 26000-24000=2000 la nham (24000 la dau trai nhom cuoi, khong phai nhom dau). Can thay sua phuong an (them 6000) hoac sua de.
